title: validation.rs: is_valid_message_id duplicates validate_message_id logic
description: crates/core/src/validation.rs: private is_valid_message_id and public validate_message_id implement the same format check independently. If the rules diverge, one will silently accept what the other rejects. Fix: implement one and delegate from the other, or remove is_valid_message_id and have call sites use validate_message_id().is_ok().
